description: Side-on photo of a tall double cheeseburger against a dark background: two beef patties with melted cheese and sauce, tomato, pickle, onion ring and lettuce in a sesame bun, on a wooden surface. A prepared dish. Expected category: prepared_meal.

Overhead photo of a long black plate holding eight pieces of nigiri sushi in a row (crab stick, tempura or egg, eel, avocado, salmon, tuna, white fish or squid, shrimp), with a small bowl of soy sauce with sesame seeds and a pair of chopsticks, all on a black surface. Prepared food. Expected category: prepared_meal.
Flat, high-contrast FDA sample Nutrition Facts panel (2014 layout) filling the picture, no product, no food. Expected category: nutrition_label.

Phone photo of a bilingual (English/Spanish) Nutrition Facts panel printed on a yellow juice-drink carton, slightly skewed, with some carton around it. The nutrition panel is the subject. Expected category: nutrition_label.
Wooden cutting board with four piles of raw diced vegetables (carrot, celery, white onion, chopped leek) and two knives. Uncooked ingredients, not a plated meal. Expected category: raw_ingredients.

White plate of fresh raw produce: cilantro, culantro leaves, a yellow onion, a garlic bulb, a long green pepper and small peppers, on a granite counter. Uncooked ingredients. Expected category: raw_ingredients.

Round wooden board with raw beef steaks and raw beef strips, a raw minced-beef patty, and three sausages or frankfurters, with rosemary, a bowl of black peppercorns, a bowl of coriander seeds, cherry tomatoes on the vine and a bunch of parsley, between two logs. Mostly uncooked meat laid out as ingredients. Expected category: raw_ingredients; prepared_meal is a weaker but defensible alternative because of the styled platter and cooked-looking sausages.

Phone photo of a creased Walmart (WM Supercenter) grocery receipt with seven abbreviated food lines (hummus, bananas, cashews, banana chips and others), a subtotal, tax and total. A supermarket receipt, not a restaurant bill. Expected category: grocery_receipt.

Faded grey scan of a 1994 Tesco supermarket receipt: ten grocery lines (jam doughnuts, cheddar, rich tea, tuna steaks, rice, a net of oranges and others), total, cash and change, 'Thank you for shopping at Tesco'. Expected category: grocery_receipt.

Scan of a dot-matrix bill from the Cave Bar of the Petra Guest House Hotel, dated Nov 10 '21 7:18PM: five drink and snack lines (a beer, herbal tea, a Sauvignon wine, Jordanian mezzeh, Jagermeister), subtotal, sales tax, service charge, 'Your Bill Is 65.205', and a 'for room charge only' signature block. A hotel bar/restaurant bill, not a supermarket receipt. Expected category: restaurant_receipt.

Phone photo of one corner of a printed restaurant menu: a dark crest 'RESTAURANTE TRES COROAS desde 1970' at the top left and the heading 'Cafetaria / Coffee' with Portuguese and English item names (Expresso, Cafe com leite / White coffee, Abatanado / Black coffee, Galao / Big white coffee, Cafe irlandes / Irish coffee, Cafe baileys); the prices on the right are cut off. Only the coffee section is visible. Expected category: restaurant_menu.
A tabby cat with green eyes sitting upright on a whitewashed wall, bare branches and sky blurred behind it. No food at all. Expected category: non_food.
A green Bianchi city bicycle with a black saddle and a rear rack carrying a folded red and yellow cloth, leaning on a textured brown wall. No food. Expected category: non_food.

Extreme close-up, slightly blurred, of an EAN-13 barcode printed on a candy package filling the whole picture, with the digits underneath reading 4 620017 455554 (13 digits: 4620017455554). No food visible, only the barcode. Expected category: has_barcode, with barcode 4620017455554 (a model that misreads a digit is wrong on the barcode; the app uses the digits for a product lookup).
